metadata.dcterms:title: Verified computations for closed hyperbolic 3-manifolds
metadata.dcterms:creator: Goerner, Matthias
metadata.dcterms:abstract: Extending methods ﬁrst used by Casson, we show how to verify a hyper- bolic structure on a ﬁnite triangulation of a closed 3-manifold using interval arith- metic methods. A key ingredient is a new theoretical result (akin to a theorem by Neumann-Zagier and Moser for ideal triangulations upon which HIKMOT is based) showing that there is a redundancy among the edge equations if the edges avoid “gim- bal lock”. We successfully test the algorithm on known examples such as the ori- entable closed manifolds in the Hodgson-Weeks census and the bundle census by Bell. We also tackle a previously unsolved problem and determine all knots and links with up to 14 crossings that have a hyperbolic branched double cover.
